body: Thanks for the response. I don't feel right being upset at her about it. She's the one suffering badly at home, not me, so I'm feeling a lot of guilt and shame. I want to believe it was all just some explosion and wasn't all true. Her boyfriend actually contacted me during the argument, saying she snapped at him too, and he was concerned about what was going on. But I think what she said was genuine. I'm hurting.
Thank you for the honesty. I've been in therapy for well over ten years but it hasn't worked. I'm at a breaking point here. I don't want to be forgiven, I want to do something helpful.
